stories.headline: Lutnick faces questions over Nvidia spy scandal. His sons' firm has deep ties to the chipmaker
stories.body: Jensen Huang’s resignation as Nvidia CEO has brought renewed scrutiny to Commerce Secretary Howard Lutnick and his family's financial ties to the chipmaker.
